purpose: Prove generated-answer competence of an explicitly selected new expert before any selector training.

architecture.expert: append copies of the final two blocks; zero attention o_proj and MLP down_proj; freeze original model
architecture.control: update the original final two blocks; no added parameters
architecture.selection: declared arm for the whole response; no router
architecture.head: frozen
architecture.initialization: expert must reproduce parent logits exactly before training
architecture.training_execution: cache frozen prefixes for training only; verify cached versus full logits before training

data.system: Answer arithmetic questions with only the final integer. Do not repeat the question or write an equation.

modular-addition: What is the remainder when {a} + {b} is divided by 7? Reply with only the number.
Add {a} and {b}, then give the remainder after division by 7. Give only the integer.
Compute ({a} + {b}) mod 7. Return only the final integer.
If I divide the sum of {a} and {b} by 7, what remainder do I get? Only the number, please.
addition: What is {a} + {b}? Reply with only the number.
Add {a} and {b}. Give only the integer.
Compute the sum of {a} and {b}. Return only the final integer.
How much is {a} plus {b}? Only the number, please.

data.split: unordered operand pairs unique across all roles; exclude all earlier staged and calibration pairs
data.replay_scope: ordinary addition practice, not previously admitted network windows

training.schedule: one deterministic shuffle, repeated for four complete passes; no quality-based stopping
training.objective: assistant tokens and EOS cross entropy; same exact loss in both arms
training.control_stop: first complete optimization step meeting the entire expert training child CPU bill plus expert-only prefix extension CPU

budget.unit: each arm cap is both process CPU seconds and wall seconds; overall wall cap takes precedence
budget.shared_preparation: charge once to lifecycle; common cost cancels; measured expert-only prefix extension is credited to control optimization target

gates.competence_only: retention losses are individually reported; no oracle, serving or promotion credit
gates.handoff: pass permits review of a separate selector contract; does not authorize selector training

novelty: Appended CPU variant using established identity-block initialization; not a claim of a new block expansion algorithm.
